transactionLog.title: Transaction log
transactionLog.subtitle: Every change to every record: who, when, what it was and what it became · append-only · kept 8 years
transactionLog.lawTitle: This log can't be switched off or edited
transactionLog.lawBody: The Companies (Accounts) Rules, Rule 3(1), require an audit trail that cannot be disabled. The database writes every insert, change and removal here itself, and refuses any edit or deletion of a line, Admin included.
transactionLog.caption: Transaction log entries
transactionLog.emptyBody: Every change made through the ERP appears here as it happens. Clear the filters to see everything.
transactionLog.noRight: Only Admin, the CA and the auditor read the transaction log. Ask Admin if you need it.

history.title: History of one record
history.noChange: No field changed in this version.
history.sealNote: Each version is kept as written. A correction makes a new version; old versions stay readable.
